ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What stage in the diagram corresponds to letter D?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a circular diagram of a butterfly life cycle: at the top C is the adult butterfly, on the right B is the small egg-like stage, at the bottom A is the caterpillar, and next to D on the left is an enclosed form hanging on a vertical surface. According to the order of butterfly metamorphic development: egg -> larva/caterpillar -> pupa/chrysalis -> adult. The hanging enclosed form corresponding to D is the chrysalis stage, namely chrysalide.
